description: This is a C# source file defining the StandaloneSiloHost class, which provides the entry point for standalone Orleans silo processes, managing startup, shutdown, process monitoring, and logging functions within the Orleans testing host environment.

classes.name: StandaloneSiloHost
classes.description: Provides the main entry point and utility methods for managing a standalone Orleans silo process in testing scenarios.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Asynchronous entry point for the silo process, initializes configuration, handles signals, logs details, and manages lifecycle.

methods.name: MonitorParentProcess
methods.description: Monitors a parent process by its ID and exits the current process if the parent exits.

methods.name: ListenForShutdownCommand
methods.description: Starts a background task to listen for a shutdown command from console input and cancels the provided CancellationTokenSource when received.

methods.name: WhenCancelled
methods.description: Extension method that returns a task which completes when the provided CancellationToken is canceled.
